## pi-web-ui 0.6.3

This release improves conversation readability and adds context and cache usage details to the composer in Web and Desktop.

- The composer shows current context use and the conversation's cache hit rate. Hover for details or click to keep the panel open. At narrow widths, the cache label hides and the model name shortens before the action buttons shrink.
- Context total and cache read/write counts come from model usage returned through the pi SDK. The four context categories are local estimates, labeled as such. A three-state demo is available in the panel.
- The message navigator now fits its content, floats beside the markers, and closes on pointer exit or outside click. Long user messages fold after eight lines while preserving tree indentation.
- Bash previews keep a dark fade and show omitted-line gaps. `grep -n` line parsing applies only to grep output, so dates and other command output remain intact.
- The file panel keeps hidden-item control in its menu and omits a zero changes badge.

Desktop installers are built for macOS, Windows, and Linux. They are unsigned; macOS may require right-click → Open, and Windows SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher prompt.
